payload.description: coordination-engine: default operation template for agent-result.json under-specifies its own contract, causing real dispatch failures. Found live during coord_state_root_rfc_20260909 (docs/history/agent-coordination-state-root/findings.md sec3/sec8): src/verbs/coordination/schema.mjs's expectedOutputs default ('agent-result.json (status, summary)') never lists the actual closed status enum (src/runner/dispatch/assignment.mjs ALLOWED_AGENT_CLAIM_STATUSES = done|blocked|failed|no-evidence), so real dispatched actors (claude-reviewer x2, codex-cli) wrote status:DONE/objection and failed schema validation on first attempt. Separately, src/runner/dispatch/assignment-runner.mjs requires a companion report artifact (e.g. agent-report.md) alongside agent-result.json for a read-only operation's done status to count as evidenced (classifyRunEvidence ~line 443-458) -- also undocumented in the default template, causing a second failed attempt even after the status enum was fixed. Fix shape: either document the enum+companion-artifact requirement explicitly in the default expectedOutputs hint, or have run.mjs inject a fuller per-operation contract template automatically. Related to agent-coordination-foundation's own scope (group-thinking/coordination-session engine); state-root-resolution investigation deliberately left this out of its own P0 scope.

payload.text: Root cause + bounded fix landed on fgw/agent-coordination-state-root (docs/history/agent-coordination-state-root/findings.md): dataDir()'s cwd-strict resolution (D5) silently accepts a real, git-tracked, but disconnected .fgos/ snapshot from any worktree made outside fgOS's own lifecycle. isSessionWorktree (src/runner/session.mjs, commit 8033890a) is an unforgeable predicate for the one legitimate non-main case (fgos session start). Wired into bin/fgos.mjs's CLI dispatch as a hand-verified per-invocation guard covering all 44 touchesState:true verbs (commits 692076c6, ecd2a9bf) -- refuses, pointing at --dir <mainRoot>, from a disconnected worktree, for 25 always-mutating verbs plus 7 genuinely mixed-mode verbs gated per-subcommand. 14 regression tests, full suite 5894/5887/0-fail verified clean.
payload.rationale: Closes this item's own root-cause description (out-of-process worker .fgos writes landing in a disconnected store) at the CLI-dispatch layer; still awaiting review/approval from the real main checkout, and item status is left untouched pending that review.
